text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Chrono Genesis got injured,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Fortunately, the symptoms were mild,
and I received prompt treatment, so..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I can go back now.
Let's hurry and resume training...!
choice_data_list: Is it okay for you to move around right away?
Are you sure it's okay to move around so soon?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The other girls who showed similar symptoms recovered quickly, too...
There is no cause for concern."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reading physical readiness down to the finest changes
and incorporating them into her methodology... That's her assessment.
It's surely not mere guesswork, but—
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, let me check your condition too.
Just to be safe, let me check your condition too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reading physical readiness down to the finest changes
and incorporating them into her methodology... That's her assessment.
It's surely not mere guesswork, but—
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, let me check your condition too.
Just to be safe, let me check your condition too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...
choice_data_list: I think Chrono has a good eye for Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...?
choice_data_list: Still, I know you sometimes push past your limits...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so.
When impatience creeps in, I just—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer... you know me so well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Please, go ahead and verify it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I had her try some light stretching, she felt a slight pain. I decided to have her take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... That's strange.
choice_data_list: Does it hurt where you're injured?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm sorry.
Even though you believed in me, I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To prevent it from worsening any further, we wrapped up training and headed home.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Phew.
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like there's any pain.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
I think I can go for one more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, um...
I was really happy... that you believed in me.
choice_data_list: You're welcome, but don't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I shall engrave it deeply upon my heart.
